title: Extended Operating Hours for Low Vice Risk Massage Shops
what_it_is: Extended Operating Hours for Low Vice Risk Massage Shops

sections.label: Extended hours for massage establishments
sections.summary: Asked whether low vice risk-exempt massage establishments with public-view massage or foot reflexology can operate beyond 10.30 pm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs whether extended operating hours beyond 10.30 pm can be allowed for low vice risk-exempt massage establishments at which massage or foot reflexology services are administered in full view of the public.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They are exempted from the need to apply for a massage establishment licence.

sections.label: Exempt massage establishment conditions
sections.summary: Exempted open-concept massage establishments must meet conditions such as no private rooms, unobscured windows and entrances, and 7.00 am to 10.30 pm operating hours.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This is to prevent them from being used as fronts for vice, as pointed out by Members of this House.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These conditions include ensuring that there are no rooms, partitions or cubicles within the premises that allow massage services to be provided in private; not obscuring any windows and entrances; and operating only from 7.00 am to 10.30 pm daily.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If the operator of an open-concept massage establishment wishes to deviate from any of these conditions, the risk associated with the establishment becomes higher.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The operator is thus required to apply for a licence instead.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Therefore, should an operator of an exempted open-concept massage establishment wish to operate beyond the stipulated hours, they should apply for a Category I massage establishment licence and request for extended operating hours.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police will assess these requests on a case-by-case basis.:

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Because for a lot of these open-concept massage places, in fact, from 10.00 pm to past midnight is actually the peak-hour timeframe for them.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Then having secured the massage establishment licence at Category I level, they can ask to be considered for extended operating hours.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The Police will look into the various factors, for example, proximity to residential areas because the stipulated hours were introduced in the first place in response to concerns about massage establishments operating 24 hours near residential areas.
